info.title: Kinship graph API
info.description: The read-only graph behind the 3D map: the configured owner's visible contacts, projects, entries, tasks and tags, and every relationship between them. lib/graph/api.generated.ts is generated from this file (npm run graph:types); never edit it by hand.

get.summary: The owner's graph, or one record's neighbourhood

parameters.name: focusId
parameters.description: A graph node id, '<type>:<database id>'. Only the records within `depth` steps of it are returned, following links in either direction.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: How many steps from the focus to include. Needs focusId. Defaults to 2.

400.description: A malformed query: a bad focusId or depth, depth without focusId, or a repeated parameter with different values

404.description: The focus is not a visible record of this owner

id.description: '<type>:<database id>': unique across types, and what focusId takes

subtitle.description: A short label: a headline, a status, a kind

description.description: A short plain-text excerpt; never a full body

url.description: The record's page in the app; null for tags, which have none

id.description: Stable identity of the directed source, target and relation

relation.description: A saved relationship's own relation, or the name of an inferred one

origins.description: Where the link came from, sorted; several when identical links were merged
